scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild src/junie.test.ts src/wakatime.test.ts src/e2e.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --out-extension:.js=.cjs --outdir=build && node --test build/junie.test.cjs build/wakatime.test.cjs build/e2e.test.cjs
scripts.version: npm run build && git add src/version.ts .claude-plugin/plugin.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json .junie-extension/marketplace.json dist/index.js

scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags
